title: Study of an Injectable Regimen of GS-3242 with Lenacapavir Compared to Biktarvy in People New to HIV-1 Treatment
official: An Operationally Seamless Phase 2/3 Randomized, Open-label, Active-Controlled Study Evaluating the Safety and Efficacy of an Injectable Regimen of GS-3242 in Combination with Lenacapavir Versus Biktarvy (Bictegravir/Emtricitabine/Tenofovir Alafenamide) in Treatment-Naive People With HIV-1
summary:
Main objective: 1. Phase 2: Part A: To evaluate the efficacy of GS-3242 plus lenacapavir (LEN, Sunlenca®) versus bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (coformulated; Biktarvy®) (B/F/TAF; 50/200/25 mg) in treatment-naive people with HIV-1 (PWH) in Treatment Groups 1, 2, and 3 at Week 35
2. Phase 2: Part B: To evaluate the efficacy of GS-3242 plus LEN versus B/F/TAF in treatment-naive PWH in Treatment Groups 4 and 3 at Week 26
3. Phase 3:  To evaluate the efficacy of GS-3242 plus LEN versus B/F/TAF in treatment-naive PWH at Week 52

interventions.name: Biktarvy 50 mg/200 mg/25 mg film-coated tablets

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. HIV-1 RNA ≥ 500 copies/mL at screening
2. ARV treatment-naive, except for prior use of oral daily PrEP or PEP up to 1 month prior to screening
Exclusion criteria:
1. Prior usage of, or exposure to LEN or GS-3242
2. Prior use of any long-acting parenteral ARV therapy (ART) medications such as monoclonal antibodies or broadly neutralizing antibodies targeting HIV-1, injectable cabotegravir (including oral cabotegravir lead-in), or injectable rilpivirine
